Real pages captured for Docdown tests by scripts/capture-docdown-fixtures.mjs.
Each folder: page.html (rendered DOM, scripts removed, open shadow roots serialized as declarative shadow DOM) + meta.json.
Content belongs to its authors under the licenses below; used here only as test input.
